title: Costs 79€ to unlock
body:
Really good app. Would definitely pay for it to unlock some premium function. But monthly payments? Come on. Or they want 79.99€ to unlock all features without an subscription. Back in the days, an app like this would have cost maybe 5 or 10€ and then you actually own the app. Now you have to rent it, or pay an insane 79.99€ to buy yourself free of subscription payments.
I used to pay for this app back in the days when they used their own servers to sync data. Now they use iCloud to sync (at no cost for the developers), no reason for a subscription payment anymore.  
Every single app wants an subscription for basic features nowadays, this is getting out of hands. 79.99€ I usual pay for complex Mac Software like video/photo editing software. But not for an simple iPhone habit tracker.

body: I trialled several tracking apps, but Strides provided the exact features I was looking for and the best functionality. title: Ziele erreichen leicht gemacht
body: Nach so einer App habe ich seit Jahren gesucht. Ideal um sich selbst Ziele zu setzen (3x Sport pro Woche, 500€ sparen, 5 kg abnehmen etc.). Die App ist leicht zu bedienen, ermöglicht es aber nahezu jedes Ziel zu überwachen. So bleibt man dauerhaft am Ball. Weiter so!
author: der-erfolgreiche-mann
